name: Customer address book
description: Allow customers to manage billing and shipping addresses
project_description: Customer address book is an Arch submodule that lets customers store and reuse billing and shipping addresses. It defines a fieldable, revisionable `addressbookitem` content entity (an Address field from the contrib Address module plus a VAT id), owned by a user, with own/any view/edit/delete permissions. Addresses can be added from the user's page, listed in Views, and reused during checkout; a UserAddressesService resolves a given user's saved addresses.
